name: gmail_search_mail
intent: Search Gmail for a term and report the subject of the first result
description: Searches Gmail using a provided search term, opens the first matching email, and reports that email's subject.
patterns: search my mail and tell me the first subject
find the first email matching a search term
what is the subject of the first matching email
search my email for this and report the top result

inputs.name: search_query
inputs.description: The term to search for in Gmail.

steps.intent: Tap the Search in mail field to start a search
Type {{search_query}} into the Search in mail field and run the search
Tap the first search result matching {{search_query}} to open it and confirm its subject

outputs.name: first_result_subject
outputs.example: Hey, you made it .. Here’s 40% off

data_values: Hey, you made it .. Here’s 40% off
